name: Rating / Marketplace Score
description: Marketplace Score product scenario for the Rating component.

controls.name: label
controls.description: Visible name of the value. Empty content leaves naming to aria-label/aria-labelledby.

controls.name: description
controls.description: Help for entering the value, announced with the focused control.

controls.name: error
controls.description: Validation message; marks the field invalid unless aria-invalid is explicit. Dynamic errors are mirrored to a polite live region.

controls.name: labelPosition
controls.description: Label above the control, or at its inline start (stacks when narrow). Defaults to top.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Controlled score, shown within 0..max; 0 means unrated. Editable stars show it rounded to the nearest choice.

controls.name: defaultValue
controls.description: Uncontrolled initial score, restored by form reset. Defaults to 0.

controls.name: max
controls.description: Number of stars, an integer from 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Blocks choosing, focus and form submission; the score stays visible.

controls.name: readOnly
controls.description: Shows the score as a meter with its exact fraction: not editable or focusable, submitted with the form, never required.

controls.name: allowHalf
controls.description: Adds a half-star choice before each star; a read-only score keeps its exact fraction either way.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Names the group when there is no visible `label`.

controls.name: aria-labelledby
controls.description: Ids of the elements that name the group; wins over `label` and `aria-label`.

controls.name: form
controls.description: Id of an external native form that owns the score.

controls.name: autoFocus
controls.description: Focuses the selected choice, else the first one, on mount.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Shared outer spacing around each star; toggling it keeps the native inputs.

controls.name: name
controls.description: Nonempty native form key; use a distinct name for each independent rating in a form.

controls.name: required
controls.description: Requires a score before an editable rating's form submits; ignored without a nonempty `name`.
